name: Limiter
description: The master limiter (D86): a brickwall limiter after the master volume, on by default at −1 dBTP (the master effects list holds it only to change or bypass it). Export: ffmpeg alimiter at 4× oversampling with a small true-peak margin; preview: a hard-knee DynamicsCompressor and a clip at the ceiling.
author: Biliup

ceilingDb.description: Ceiling in dBTP. Used down to −12 (clamped).
